_about: Synthetic bug / defect / capability tracker for the sensor node. Edit by hand or let /track-and-report do it. Schema: docs in templates/tracker-item.json.

items.title: Filter output biased by one LSB for negative readings during warm-up
items.notes: Root cause: floor division in an early Python twin. Fixed to truncate toward zero to match C.

items.title: Host parser accepted packets with reserved flag bits set
items.notes: Reserved bits now rejected at build time; parse still tolerant for forward compatibility.

items.title: MCU busy-waits between samples; sleep mode not entered
items.notes: Power budget shows 2.97 mA vs 2.7 mA limit (28.1 days vs 30). Highest-value open item.

items.title: IMU reinit counter not reported in any packet field
items.notes: Host can see IMU_REINIT flag but not how often it happens. Consider a diagnostics packet type.

items.title: Temperature fault flag clears after one packet even if sensor still out of range
items.notes: Behaviour is per spec (flag = event) but reviewers expected a latched state. Spec clarification proposed.

items.title: Implement low-power sleep between samples
items.notes: Resolves SN-BUG-003. Estimated: MCU duty 40 % -> 25 %, life 28 -> 40 days.

items.title: CAN uplink option for multi-node deployments
items.notes: See ADR-0002 and parts/can-xcvr.json. Needs 5 V rail; power impact must be re-budgeted.

items.title: Evaluate IMU B as lower-power drop-in replacement
items.notes: Same footprint, 0.35 mA vs 0.55 mA. Run /what-if-part-swap imu-a -> imu-b.

items.title: Host-side packet decoder library with CRC validation
Diagnostics packet (reinit count, uptime, battery voltage)
items.notes: Would close SN-BUG-004. Needs an ICD change (new SYNC value or FLAGS bit).
